title: [3.2.0.1] AAPSClient crash because of VirtualPump driver on NS sync
body:
AAPSclient were working fine for about a day after built, but then became crashing on both my and my wife's phones.
Logs shows that Pump driver error is forcing app to exit. How's that possible for aapsclient?

Yes, VirtualPump plugin starts invisibli for aapsclient and then at some point sends 'driver changed' event, that crashes app.
This is from aapsclient startup log

ok, got it - somehow added broken record to `devicestatus` collection - this forces both aaps/aapsclient to crash on receiving it from NS
Just curious, are you using NSClient v1 or v3 (ws on or off)?  I'm setting up an extra AAPSclient in my testrig to see if I can reproduce.

I'm on v1 (because changing and applying profile via NS UI) WS On.
Reproducing is very simple: go to `/api-docs/`, there choose `POST /devicestatus`, try out, execute. It will add a devicestatus record with default values in all fields. This record will force AAPS/AAPSClient to exit on receiving it from NS.
This record wont appear in aaps app log, but it will trigger the pump changed event with immediate app close.
